text:
kevin: Heads-up — opened PR #6128 to flatten feature flags inside the `model-config` ConfigMap and rename TF keys to `flags.*`. Need eng-infra + platform review before we run terraform apply.

maria: Nice. Can you outline the migration path? How do we keep per-model overrides working during rollout?

kevin: Short plan: 1) TF rename (state move + new key names) 2) kube apply the updated configmap 3) rolling restart for affected runtimes 4) monitor Console metrics and flag-loader errors. Trying to avoid code-side dual-read. If we need a gradual approach we can do a short canary in staging.

sam: Will pods pick up the changed keys automatically or do we need a restart? Some services only read config on start.

kevin: Good call — a restart is required for many of the model runtime processes. We’ll annotate deployments and `kubectl rollout restart` them after the CM update. We’ll target one region and the non-critical model pool first.

alex: Also watch for secret wiring — nothing in this PR should move sensitive values from secrets -> configmap. Confirmed?

kevin: Absolutely not moving secrets. The TF change is limited to `data` keys in `kubernetes_config_map.model_config`. Secret objects unaffected.

ci-bot: PR check failed — tests/flag_loader_test.py::test_missing_keys — KeyError: 'old_flag_name'

kevin: Seeing that. I added a small test shim to map legacy names in test only; real runtime won’t do mapping. The CI failure is due to test expectations — pushing fix now.

jonathan: If we want safety and minimal user impact, consider a 2-week dual-read window where the loader tries new key first then falls back to `legacy_*` keys. That buys rollback time without TF surgery.

maria: Dual-read is safer but increases runtime complexity. If we can do a staged rollout with thorough evals, I’m fine skipping dual-read. Can we do a canary for 24–48h and auto-rollback on error thresholds?

kevin: Yes — we’ll: a) apply in staging, b) canary in us-west1 non-prod, c) monitor 5xx/errors, latency, and `flag-mismatch` logs for 48h, d) rollback TF rename if we hit thresholds.

sam: What thresholds? Suggest >0.5% error increase OR any user-affecting 5xx spike.

alex: Don’t forget console mapping — update the Redwood Console docs so Product sees new flag key names (and the UI mapping for per-model overrides).

kevin: Will update docs PR after CI is green. Also will add a small TF plan snippet in the PR description:

```
  # terraform plan excerpt
  - kubernetes_config_map.model_config.data["models/model_a/flags/old_name"] = "on"
  + kubernetes_config_map.model_config.data["flags.model_a.new_name"] = "on"
```

maria: FYI, runbook should mention `kubectl rollout restart` and the exact deployment selectors.

kevin: Already added runbook section in the PR notes. I’ll tag eng-oncall and sched a Monday 10:30 PT window for apply if no blockers.

jonathan: Sounds good. +1 to the plan. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI passed on the latest push.

kevin: Great — I’ll wait for @eng-infra review and then schedule the canary. If anyone has objections to Monday 10:30 PT, speak up here.

maria: No objections from Product.

sam: Ok for SRE side.

alex: Signed off on secrets/ownership.

kevin: Thanks all — will update the PR and post a short postmortem template in case we need it after the canary.
